audit_existing_v9.required_new: central version route, closed config/context/bundle/selection/checkpoint/metrics/ledger/plan/run schemas; local same protocol + explicit unrelated memory kind; no parallel engine

control_rule.content: predeclared ASCII text about typesetting punctuation; explicitly NON_EVIDENCE, no packing advice, measured numbers or invented claims
control_rule.factor: relevant evidence vs unrelated additional prompt content
control_rule.length: canonical JSON entry chars AND UTF-8 bytes exactly equal paired E fragment; array overhead identical; tolerance zero
control_rule.mutability: one deterministic version; no alternate seeds or result-dependent reconstruction
control_rule.residual_difference: different fields/meaning and repetitive filler; equal bytes do not equate tokens, attention or semantic information
control_rule.selection: same frozen E public query, source exclusions, ranking and whole-entry budgets; replace admitted E fragment by paired placebo

empty_hit: retain registered method identity with explicit empty MemoryView
execution_protocol: UNASSIGNED_BLOCKED; cannot describe proposed v10 as implemented

information_budget.actual_token_lengths: report from sent body, not assumed equal; E placebo exact canonical byte length only

instruction: Packaging/load protocol v1: use current geometry, mass, support eligibility and capacity only.

native_model_observations.determinism: UNKNOWN; no repeat pilot, no claim of immutable model weights
native_model_observations.probabilities: preserve raw native precision and availability; no inferred reasons or confidence; provider tie policy UNKNOWN unless documented
native_model_observations.service_drift: served model or dependency change stops batch; no silent mixed repetitions

objective: Complete loading while preserving useful space and capacity using observed facts; physical constraints are mandatory.

physics.forbidden: PCT prefilter/reordering/labels, alternate choice on failure, physical parameter or tolerance changes; area ledger separate
physics.order: original candidates -> independent choice -> save -> independent-state monitor -> save -> original commit or stop

private_source_exclusion: entire connected component aliases/variants/forks excluded from T/E/control before scoring
public_input: current public state+criteria only; no future arrivals, private task, PCT diagnoses or source IDs as scoring features
question: Choose one complete box-and-placement action from the shared physical candidate pool. Use only currently observed boxes, their mass, capacity and cumulative top loads. Aim to place the order and preserve useful space and supporting capacity. Every action must pass the shared physical checks. No future arrivals are known.
recovery: persist DECISION_READY body/query/view/snapshot before sending; saved choice/monitor/commit immutable; no resend/retrieve/reselect/remonitor/recommit

retrieval.distance: mean absolute normalized feature distance; score=1/(1+distance)

historical_result_budget.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

retrieval.scales: container dimensions, payload; capacity uses max(payload,1); placed volume/container volume
retrieval.truncation: whole entries only; never remove conditions, costs or limitations

service_contract_reference: parent JN3-C official_api_contract.json; identity/official protocol must be checked before freezing an executable replacement plan; no auth loaded here
singleton: zero model sends; view hits and actual request injections counted separately
source_of_truth: same exact base prompt/body encoding for all remote methods; only registered memory varies
